posts.title: I Built a KMP Library for In-App Updates (So You Don't Have To)
posts.description: Introducing kmp-app-updater — a Kotlin Multiplatform library that handles checking for updates, downloading them, and installing them on Android and Desktop. With pluggable update sources and Compose UI components.
